tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Near-black, slightly warm; the paper tint in Daylight. Everything sits on this or on `panel`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel and card fill. One step off `ground` — the difference is a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, popovers, the active tile, inset wells inside a panel.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Sunken areas inside a panel: chart beds, code, empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel frames, dividers, grid lines, corner marks. 1px, never thicker.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Frames that must read on their own (a focused panel, a table rule) and the plus-grid pattern. 1.9:1 on ground — texture and structure, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals, on ground, panel and panel-raised. 17:1 dark, 16:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, descriptions, axis text, on any surface. 9:1 dark, 7.3:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, placeholders, disabled labels, on ground and panel. 4.9:1 dark on ground, 4.5:1 on panel-raised; 4.6:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` or `ink` fill (the accent button, a filled keycap).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The hot accent. Active state, the one primary action, the live value, selection. As text on ground, panel and signal-soft: 11:1 dark, 4.9:1 light.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a `signal` fill or text.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `signal` text — selected rows, active tabs, the current tile.

tokens.name: signal-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 1px solid plus 1px offset; also the frame of the focused panel. 11:1 / 4.9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: The cool accent. Secondary series, links, the comparison value, positive change. As text on ground and panel: 10:1 dark, 5.3:1 light.

tokens.name: cool-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `cool` text.

tokens.name: cool-fill
tokens.usage: Solid cool fill for bars, the featured tile and the selected calendar day. Text on it: `ink` in Dark (5.3:1), `ink-inverse` in Daylight (6.3:1).

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: The third, playful accent — lime. Empty states, loaders, ASCII faces, a finished run, celebration. Never a primary action, never a status. As text on ground and panel: 15:1 dark, 5.4:1 light.

tokens.name: play-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `play` text.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Positive change: the delta, the rising sparkline. Alias-equivalent of `cool` so up and down differ in hue AND lightness.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Negative change and errors: the falling delta, an invalid field, a failed run. As text on ground, panel and down-soft: 7.1:1 dark, 5.0:1 light.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `down` text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution — the same hue as `signal`, so a warning always carries a word or icon. Use sparingly; `signal` already means attention.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, online, passed. Status dots and words only, never a fill; paired with `down` (orange) so the two differ in lightness. 9.6:1 dark, 5.1:1 light.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `ok` text.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines: the + gutter and the line text. Same as ok.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Added-line background.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines: the − gutter and the struck text. Same as down — green vs orange, never green vs red.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Removed-line background.

tokens.name: diff-hunk
tokens.usage: The @@ hunk header. Same as cool.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 = signal.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 = cool.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 = ink (the baseline / total).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 = secondary; dotted or thinner than 1–3.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 = down; reserve for an anomaly or threshold line.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dot and plus grids drawn behind canvases at `space-6` pitch. Texture only.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Connector lines between nodes and panels at rest; 1px, orthogonal or gently curved. Same as line-strong.

tokens.name: edge-active
tokens.usage: The connector on the path you are following — the hovered or selected edge and its two ports. Same as signal.

tokens.name: edge-cool
tokens.usage: A second highlighted path (comparison, data flow vs control flow).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind a dialog or an inactive panel group.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The headline value of a Stat tile. Tabular figures; one per panel.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: Secondary values, counters in a grid of tiles.

styles.name: delta
styles.usage: Change readouts next to a numeral, in `up` or `down`.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Panel titles, tile labels, axis titles — uppercase, `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Keyboard hints inside Keycap, in buttons and the status bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Expected increase from 11am due to the parade.
styles.usage: Descriptions and prose, `ink-secondary`. The only size for paragraphs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Fixed keyboard shortcuts on profile to only work with F.
styles.usage: List items, changelog lines, table cells.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Panels are tight: the system is dense by design, and whitespace comes from the grid gutter, not from padding.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Corner-mark offset, dot-to-word gap inside Status.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Keycap padding, gap between a numeral and its unit.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; panel title bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, button horizontal padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on wide tiles; gap between label and numeral.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter between panels; the dot/plus grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter; gap between panel groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Sidebar width unit; chart bed minimum height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Status-bar-to-content clearance; section gap on a long page.

radius.note: Sharp frames, soft nodes. Panels are instruments; the things you drag around are toys.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, frames, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps, badges, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Nodes on a canvas, ASCII art frames, the playful bits. The one friendly radius.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the featured tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the outer app window only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, ring gauges.

shadow.note: No drop shadows. Depth is a 1px frame; focus and selection are a second frame in signal.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The panel frame (= `line`). Every panel, every tile.

tokens.name: frame-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered panel, table header rule.

tokens.name: frame-signal
tokens.usage: The focused or selected panel; a focused control.

tokens.name: frame-down
tokens.usage: A panel or field in error.

terminal.note: How each colour role renders in the terminal face: a 256-colour index, with the 16-colour name the TUI falls back to when the terminal reports no more. Truecolor terminals use the hex from the colour family directly.

tokens.name: term-ground
tokens.usage: Page. 16-colour: default background (never paint it).

tokens.name: term-panel
tokens.usage: Panel fill. 16-colour: default background; the frame alone carries the panel.

tokens.name: term-panel-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected row fill. 16-colour: reverse video on the row.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Box-drawing frames and rules (│ ─ ┌ ┐ └ ┘ ├ ┤). 16-colour: bright black (8).

tokens.name: term-line-strong
tokens.usage: Focused frame when signal is unavailable, grid dots (·). 16-colour: bright black (8).

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals. 16-colour: bright white (15).

tokens.name: term-ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels and body. 16-colour: white (7).

tokens.name: term-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata. 16-colour: bright black (8) — the one place contrast drops below 4.5:1; keep it to timestamps.

tokens.name: term-signal
tokens.usage: The hot accent: active frame, selected text, the followed edge. 16-colour: yellow (3).

tokens.name: term-cool
tokens.usage: Links, second series, up. 16-colour: blue (4), bright blue (12) on dark terminals.

tokens.name: term-play
tokens.usage: Faces, loaders, celebrations. 16-colour: bright green (10).

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy status. 16-colour: green (2).

tokens.name: term-down
tokens.usage: Failed, removed lines, negative deltas. 16-colour: red (1).

tokens.name: term-warn
tokens.usage: Same as signal; always with a word.

tokens.name: term-edge
tokens.usage: Connector characters (─ │ ┐ └ ╭ ╮) at rest. 16-colour: bright black (8).

tokens.name: term-edge-active
tokens.usage: The followed connector. 16-colour: yellow (3).

cells.note: The terminal grid. One cell is 1ch × 1 line; the desktop face maps it to the px scale so both faces share proportions.

tokens.name: cell-w
tokens.usage: One column ≈ space-2 (8px) at code size. Panel padding is 1 column; gutters between panels are 2.

tokens.name: cell-h
tokens.usage: One row ≈ space-5 (20px) at code size. A panel head is 1 row plus 1 rule; a Stat is 3 rows (label, numeral, foot).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: The collapsed-sibling rail when a panel is open: 3 columns, titles written down them one glyph per row.

tokens.name: status-h
tokens.usage: The bottom status bar: one row, keycaps left, context right.

tokens.name: numeral-xl-rows
tokens.usage: A 56px numeral in the desktop face is drawn as 3-row figlet-style block digits in the terminal; `numeral-lg` is 1 row bold, `numeral` is 1 row.
